purpose: Keep reusable authoring sources shared while every deployed lesson owns a complete, relocatable runtime bundle.

ownership.authoringSource: Shared CSS, JavaScript, audio, and approved generated assets remain canonical under _shared/ or _engine/.
ownership.deploymentOutput: A lesson owns deterministic runtime copies under assets/runtime-vendor/ and must run without parent-repository or network dependencies.
ownership.assetMeaning: A byte-identical, manifest-bound deployment copy is not a new generated asset and does not replace its canonical provenance record.

adoption.rule: New lessons and directly changed legacy lesson runtimes must adopt this contract. Untouched legacy lessons stay frozen until their next runtime change.

crossProductBoundary.sharedPrinciple: Socialmon and Sciencemon may reuse the source-shared/deployment-owned principle.
crossProductBoundary.rule: Do not apply this Mathmon dependency graph or rollout list to another product; each product requires its own adapter and final gate.
